water-works-v1.title: Water Works
water-works-v1.skill: Guide water through pipes, valves and branches
levels: Tap the wheel to open the valve. Press Go to send the water.
Turn the curved pipe until its ends join the path. Press Go to try it.
Pick up the spare pipe. Tap the empty square to place it, then turn it to join the path.
Water can split in two. Close the leaking branch and send the water to the flag.
Both flags need water. Follow each branch and connect both paths.

train-tracks-v1.title: Train Tracks
train-tracks-v1.skill: Connect tracks and switch a train onto a route
levels: Tap the loose track to turn it. Press Go to drive to the flag.
Pick up the curved track. Tap the empty square to place it, then turn it toward the station.
Tap the switch to choose a track. Press Go and watch which way the train goes.
Pick up the passenger on the way to the station. Try the switch and the bend.
Find a way to pick up the passenger and reach the flag. You can change both switches.
